top_signals.title: US Stocks Fall as Tech Concerns Linger Despite Rates Relief
top_signals.summary: US equities edged lower Friday as investors continue to digest the impact of a global software outage at Microsoft Corp. and turmoil at Nvidia Corp., even as wholesale inflation data helped ease fears of an outsized interest-rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Chip Rout Outweighs Inflation Data: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A renewed slide in chipmakers weighed on stocks, overshadowing inflation data that had eased concern about aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
